info.name: ShootProof Studio API (Curated Subset) Clients API

description.content:
Curated subset of ShootProof's public Studio Panel API, covering the Studios/Brands, Events & Galleries, Photos, Clients (Contacts), Orders, and Contracts resources. Endpoints, methods, and paths below are drawn directly from ShootProof's live OpenAPI 3.0 document (https://developer.shootproof.com/oas/studio.json), which as of the review date defines 157 paths and 181 schemas across Brands, Contacts, Contracts, Email, Events, Invoices, Music, Orders, Price Sheets, and more. This file is a representative curated subset for cataloging purposes, not a full mirror - fetch the live document for the complete, authoritative spec. The API is RESTful and hypermedia-driven (HAL-style `links` objects on every response) and secured with three-legged OAuth 2.0; not all resources are exposed identically across every scope.

Contact Support:
 Name: ShootProof
 Email: support@shootproof.com
